1a6d2082766d3f11646bd972c1bc12effb304cb2.note: Selected part of #126; ownership and capacity handling are out of scope for this release.

source.pull_requests: One functional item per pull request is opened at the release checkpoint; no pull-request numbers are claimed here.

container.note: Image named by the release defaults in this branch; the build has not run, so the tag does not exist yet. Digest, build and promotion identities are recorded when the image is published.

changes.summary: Accept absent or null budget_tokens for enabled thinking in the Anthropic route: the request uses the existing reasoning-enabled conversion. Explicit budgets keep their validation, and disabled/adaptive field rules are unchanged.

changes.author: John Pezzulli
changes.summary: A reasoning.effort supplied on a /v1/responses request now outranks the launch default through the existing request-first template policy. Nested overrides, omitted or null effort, summary-only schema defaults and explicit thinking-off controls keep their behavior; direct renderer precedence is retained for callers that do not opt in.

Reject incomplete FILE-backed NIXL restores: empty objects are lookup misses and each physical object is validated against its host-buffer byte count before a read. Missing, short and metadata-query failures return the existing failed-read result; complete and padded objects stay valid. Adapts sgl-project/sglang#46131 with bounded query-error handling for Penny prefetch workers.

QSA retains prefix index keys in narrow speculative windows: two pending index-key ring groups for speculative widths 2 through the compression ratio, allocation still tied to the launch maximum, undersized or unresolved verify geometry refused by the existing guard, and the group-partitioned layout from #40143 preserved. Adapts sgl-project/sglang#46125.

Truncated hybrid-Mamba prefill chunks are floored to the KV page size before commit, so a cached hybrid state is never named by a key shorter than the prefix it summarizes; a chunk with under one page of budget is parked and retried on the existing deferral path. No-op unless the cache holds Mamba state on a paged pool; untruncated tails and full-attention profiles are untouched. Restates sgl-project/sglang#45607 against this fork's PrefillAdder.
profiles: Hybrid Mamba profiles under chunked prefill

changes.summary: Drop the prefill-only qualifier on the empty-batch reset of the batch_is_full latch, so a running batch that emptied through ordinary decode reopens admission instead of starving while freed request-to-token rows sit unused. Non-empty batches still reset only on a shrink. This is the selected hunk of #126; the ownership and capacity changes are not included.

Maturity labeling corrected in current guidance: 27B + DFlash2 is established and qualified, and only the optional Flash-Next next-dflash2 profile keeps the experimental / alpha label. The draft's additional host cache stays documented on both DFlash2 profiles, separate from maturity. Labels and documentation only - no setting, default, launch line, runtime module or test changed.

defaults_unchanged.native_mtp_width_policy: tiered (block 8 at one running request, block 4 at two or more)
defaults_unchanged.operator_local_selection: adaptive width policy, medium reasoning effort, diagnostics off
defaults_unchanged.note: No settings or default changes in this release; the width-policy rows in RESULTS.md were measured with adaptive selected.

validation.focused_cpu_checks: 2026-10-27 on this candidate, CPU only: integrated suite passed 409 tests with 404 subtests and 1 optional S3 skip. Documentation and release-identity preparation reran the focused setup/recipe/version checks and pinned formatting without rerunning runtime qualification.
validation.review: Each of the six fixes was reviewed individually and accepted; exact patch-id equality with the accepted contributions was verified.
validation.regression: The focused regressions for #109, #122, #123, #124 and the Responses effort fix are red on the 742cbc5 base and green with the fix.
validation.cuda_regression: Fixed-W4 QSA coverage ran on the production shape with retained-prefix residues of 1, 2 and 3 tokens, partial acceptance and fused compression; serving checks passed 9/9.
validation.api_probes: Both profiles passed 4/4 API probes, a sealed agentic run of 6 turns with 5 tool calls, vision checks, and correct 63,906-token and 489,921-token retrieval.
validation.cache_restore: Fresh-process 64K and 490K NIXL restores were correct on both profiles: 553,792 NIXL-backed KV tokens plus 4 Mamba states each, and additionally 4,096 sliding-window tokens on 27B. Both restart restores are valid. Duplicate replays answered from the device cache rather than four independent disk loads.
validation.reasoning: All 36 measured requests completed naturally with no confirmed loops; extended reasoning is not penalized. Blind scores: Flash-Next native MTP 95.36 (sequential) and 97.61 (three concurrent users); 27B DFlash2 98.67 and 99.23.
validation.tools: Not universal. Flash-Next native MTP: 30/30 parseable, 29/30 strict, 26/30 automatic; automatic misses include scorer/date substring behavior and mock-router behavior. 27B DFlash2: 30/30 scheduled, exact and parseable, 28/30 automatic; two invalid-date answers exhausted 512 tokens entirely in reasoning with empty visible answers, and one invoice answer added unwanted explanatory prose. Agentic and vision checks passed separately.
validation.benchmarks: Dated native mean/peak rates and cold TTFT for this candidate are recorded in RESULTS.md with the measured policy, configuration, source and interval counts. No matched-baseline speed-up claim is made and no new performance default changed.
validation.container_build: Pending. The GPU container smoke check is still pending under separate publication coordination and is not claimed as passed here.
exceptions: The first 27B four-request screen stopped with an Xid 109 GPU freeze; the unchanged retry after a host reboot completed. Cause unproven, no freeze fix claimed, detailed incident note kept as an internal observation.

Cache-pressure eviction rather than pure-host retention was accepted; host checkpoint reclamation and the disk-budget cleaner were both in play, so pure-host retention was not isolated. Not a blocker and not a testing instruction.
The on-GPU DFlash2 checkpoint-grid resume is still not exercised on either DFlash2 profile; the #115 arithmetic fix remains CPU-regression-covered.
